subject: Human permanent dentition - 32 FDI teeth, pulp, gums, jaw bone
pivotRule: Every tooth node origin is the cervical centre: the point on the long axis at the cemento-enamel junction (CEJ). The root goes to local -Y, the crown to local +Y.

localFrame.viewer: +Y = coronal (root -> crown), +Z = facial (lip/cheek side), +X = mesial when mesialSign = +1, distal when -1
localFrame.blender: +Z = coronal, -Y = facial, +X = mesial when mesialSign = +1, distal when -1 (glTF export with +Y up converts this to the viewer frame)
localFrame.crownRegion: local y in [0, dims.crownHeight]; root region local y in [-dims.rootLength, 0]

archFormula.form: x = a*sin(u)^(2/p); z = zFront - b*(1 - cos(u)^(2/p)); u in [0, pi/2]; straight tail after the widest point
archFormula.passesThrough: crown centre at 0.6 of crown height
archFormula.placement: tooth i sits at arc length sum(md of teeth before it) + md/2 from the midline; right side is the mirror (x -> -x)

templates.note: Threaded titanium screw. Origin at the platform centre (top), body along -Y (viewer) / -Z (Blender). Length 11.5, platform diameter 4.1.
Tapered titanium post. Origin at its base centre, rises along +Y (viewer). Height 5.5, base diameter 4.1, top diameter 2.8, small collar.
Short dome cap. Origin at base centre, height 3, diameter 4.6.

Twin bracket with base pad, four tie wings and a horizontal archwire slot. Origin at the centre of the pad back face; pad lies in the local XY plane (viewer), bracket projects to +Z by 1.9. Pad 3.2 wide (X) by 2.8 tall (Y). Slot runs along X.
Tapered fibre post. Origin at the top centre, runs along -Y (viewer). Length 9, top diameter 1.5, tip diameter 0.9.
